title: G4 LENS GUITARRA (Flamenco Tech-House × Rumba) [122]
style: flamenco meets tech-house and rumba, 122 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave Spanish Andalusian + Catalan + te reo Maori, fiery Spanish nylon guitar runs and rasgueado strums, palmas handclap patterns, cajon rhythm pocket, deep tech-house sub bass, four-on-the-floor kick with percussive shaker layers, castanets, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, sun-soaked tablao-meets-club mood, sidechain pumping pads to kick, festival 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Spanish guitar rasgueado, soft palmas, cajon tap)
(G4... LENS... gui... tar... ra...)
(o... le... o... le...)
(ti... ti... ro... ti... ti...)

[Build]
(palmas double up, cajon roll, sub slides up)
G4! LENS! GUI — TAR — RA!
O — LE! O — LE!
TI — TI — RO! TI — TI — RO!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(castanet roll, riser sweep)

[Drop 1]
(four-on-the-floor tech-house, flamenco guitar lead)
G4 — LENS!
GUI — TAR — RA!
MI — RA!
VE — LO!
(chop stack +7) ole-ole-si-si / āe-āe-ole-ole
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(guitar solo run, chops trade left-right)
(qué ves?) (què veus?) (kei te kite?)
(¡lo veo!) (ho veig!) (kei te kite au!)
(¡mira!) (mira!) (titiro!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE FOCUS —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to nylon guitar + cajon alone, no kick)
(whispered) g4... lens... guitarra...
(soft) o... le... o... le...
(soft) titiro... titiro...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(palmas roll builds, kick returns)

[Drop 2]
(double-time tech-house, full flamenco stack peak)
G4 — LENS — GUI — TAR — RA! (ole ole ole!)
MI — RA! (ho veig! titiro!)
VE — LO! (¡lo veo! kei te kite!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(cajon fades, guitar resolves with rasgueado)
(g4... lens... guitarra...)
(o... le... o... le...)
(titiro... titiro...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(final guitar strum, palmas clap, silence)
